notes.title: Full Controller Support!
notes.notes:
In a sadistic commitment to rewriting user interface code, I've finally completed the update to allow full controller support. Easily swap between tools and use joysticks to control your movement and camera. 

I think it feels pretty good and intuitive to use, but please reach out to me if you have any issues or suggestions!

Thanks for playing my game - you all rock :)

-Thomas

notes.title: Bug Fixes Round 1
notes.notes:
Well howdy my favorite peoples!

Here's a list of fixes that just made their way into the game:

[list]
[*]Added a confirmation popup when trashing a level
[*]Fixed issue where objects would stay highlighted after deselecting the eraser tool
[*]Reduced the amount of undo & erase actions needed to complete objectives
[*]Removed a debug command that could accidentally hide the HUD
[*]Increased clarity around certain objective descriptions
[/list]

Thanks for your input!
If you haven't left a review yet, I would very much appreciate it!

Thanks,
Thomas

notes.title: Bridges & Docks Launch! Woohoo!
notes.notes:
Hello and welcome to a very fun event - the game's launch!

I've had a ton of fun working on this game, and I'm very excited to see what you all create with it.

I'll be busy for the near future doing lots of bug fixes & content updates, so feel free to ping me on discord or via the in-game bug form for suggestions or issues.

Thanks to everyone who has encourage me along the way, and I hope you enjoy the game!
